Brand imagery refers to the set of associations and perceptions that consumers have about a brand, including its extrinsic attributes like color, packaging, and consistency, as well as how these satisfy psychological or social needs.  
Brand repositioning involves changing the target market or brand image.  
Brand stretching refers to extending a brand into new product categories.  
Brand equity is the overall value of the brand to the company.  
The description in the question best matches brand imagery.  

Final answer: (D)
